summary: Phase 0-3 admission is green and the repaired validator now rejects numeric stop-loss, provider-output, locator, coordinated-input, and candidate/review/owner lifecycle mutations. Phase 4 still fails because production acceptance permits inherited predecessor context and ignores frozen task ownership, while committed role evidence is incomplete, stale, and not a current provider-resolved five-role set.

blocking_findings.title: Frozen fresh-context and task ownership are not enforced
blocking_findings.detail: The frozen strategy requires five pairwise-isolated fork_turns=none roles with role-owned tasks and outputs. Production checks fork_turns only for adversarial-reviewer and does not validate ownership.incompatible_roles, ownership.tasks, or receipt task_id. The committed Green fixture uses fork_turns=all for four predecessor roles. Changing every receipt task_id to forged-unowned-task still returned {"ok": true}.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Bind receipts and provider events to frozen task_id and expected outputs; enforce distinct fresh fork_turns=none sessions for every incompatible role; add task/output substitution, shared-session, and inherited-predecessor negative controls.

blocking_findings.title: Committed receipts are incomplete and stale
blocking_findings.detail: Required roles are discovery-auditor, evidence-collector, requirements-mapper, truth-test-author, and adversarial-reviewer. Only three receipt files exist; requirements-mapper.json declares reconciliation-integrator, leaving requirements-mapper, truth-test-author, and adversarial-reviewer missing and reconciliation-integrator unexpected. Discovery lacks required event/context provenance, measured usage, numeric stop-loss, and canonical aggregate output hash; evidence-collector lacks stop-loss; mapper lacks exact role, most provenance, measured usage, and stop-loss. HEAD output mismatches are discovery 3/3, evidence 2/4, mapper 1/1. No committed provider event map binds current outputs, and all Phase-4 review/candidate/owner/accepted artifacts are absent.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Truthfully rerun every missing or stale predecessor role with provider-resolved fresh context, exact current-output hashes, numeric usage and stop-loss fields; then run adversarial review, publish non-consumable candidates, and request exact-hash owner approval.

nonblocking_findings.title: Earlier stop-loss and provider-output bugs are repaired
nonblocking_findings.detail: Exact numeric stop-loss keys/thresholds and provider-to-receipt output-map equality are now enforced; missing, null, boolean, negative, threshold, omitted, extra, stale, and forged controls reject.

nonblocking_findings.title: Authority, locator, coordinated-input, and hash lifecycle controls are non-vacuous
nonblocking_findings.detail: Controls reject frozen authority/ceiling redefinition, malformed nested locators, quarantine/root/revision/hash violations, worktree-only bytes, stale candidate/review/owner bindings, early owner approval, and replay.
